bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 42515416 (freetype2): Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 1 found by fuzz target ftfuzzer [asan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42515416
bug_description.normalized: A staged OpenType/CFF2 variable font causes FreeType to allocate a 96-byte CFF size object, then drive MVAR post-processing through the TrueType metrics-variation path. `tt_apply_mvar` iterates `face->sizes_list`, `tt_size_reset_iterator` casts the CFF size entry to `TT_Size`, and vulnerable `tt_size_reset` writes the TrueType-only `ttmetrics.valid` field without the later `face->isCFF2` early return, producing a 1-byte heap-buffer-overflow write.

source.description: First project parser step that consumes the attacker-controlled OpenType table directory and checks whether the loaded face carries a `CFF2` table, selecting the CFF2 path that the later fix must exclude from TrueType size reset.
source.value_from: The exact staged `poc` is the 3984-byte OpenType font at `gt_results/arvo_42515416/poc` with SHA-256 `0aa475ed5d4161c5cd1bf244d869338500d25bf2b368a959132b99f94782d681`. Its SFNT directory begins with `OTTO` and contains `CFF2` (offset 2736, length 878), `MVAR` (offset 3844, length 54), and `fvar` (offset 3900, length 84); this `goto_table(..., TTAG_CFF2, ...)` lookup is the first project statement that materializes the CFF2 property used by the vulnerable path.

root_cause.description: Root cause. `tt_size_reset` performs a TrueType-only field write before any CFF2 early return. For the CFF2 face traced here, `size` actually aliases the smaller `CFF_SizeRec` allocated in `FT_New_Size`, so the missing `if ( face->isCFF2 ) return FT_Err_Ok;` guard added by the fix is the obligation that would have prevented the overflow.
root_cause.note: The fix commit inserts `face = (TT_Face)size->root.face;` and `if ( face->isCFF2 ) return FT_Err_Ok;` immediately before this statement in `tt_size_reset`.

sink.description: ASan crash site. The write to `size->ttmetrics.valid` lands outside the 96-byte size allocation because the iterator passed a CFF size object through the TrueType reset path.
sink.note: The saved AddressSanitizer report records `heap-buffer-overflow` `WRITE of size 1` at `ttobjs.c:1215:27` in `tt_size_reset`, on address `0x508000000278`, with stack `tt_size_reset -> tt_size_reset_iterator -> FT_List_Iterate`.

parser_admitted.description: The witness passes the `TTAG_OTTO` admission gate in `cff_face_init`, so FreeType continues the OpenType/CFF parser and reaches the later `CFF2` table lookup.

variation_api_reached.description: The saved ftfuzzer path reaches the `if ( instance_index == 0 )` gate, so the face is opened with no named instance selected (`face_index` bits 16-30 are 0); `setIntermediateAxis` then computes midpoint coordinates `( minimum + def ) / 2` and calls `FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates`.

tainted_value_origin.description: FreeType wraps the staged `poc` bytes and length into an in-memory face-opening request before parsing the font directory.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: The untrusted data are the exact 3984 bytes of `gt_results/arvo_42515416/poc` (SHA-256 `0aa475ed5d4161c5cd1bf244d869338500d25bf2b368a959132b99f94782d681`).

coarse_trace.summary: FreeType parses the staged OpenType font as CFF2 and loads its `MVAR` data, materializing `face->isCFF2 = 1` and `TT_FACE_FLAG_VAR_MVAR` on the face.

During face open, `FT_New_Size` allocates the face's active size object using the CFF driver's `size_object_size`, producing the 96-byte `CFF_SizeRec` that ASan later reports, and links it into `face->sizes_list`.

On the `instance_index == 0` path, ftfuzzer opens the face with no named instance selected and `setIntermediateAxis` passes midpoint axis coordinates `(minimum + def) / 2` to `FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates`; the CFF metrics-variation service then forwards that request into the TrueType metrics-variation implementation.
`tt_apply_mvar` observes the loaded `MVAR` flag, iterates every entry in `face->sizes_list`, and `tt_size_reset_iterator` reinterprets the CFF size pointer as `TT_Size`.
The vulnerable TrueType reset path writes `size->ttmetrics.valid` on the miscast CFF size object with no CFF2 early return, causing the out-of-bounds heap write reported by ASan.

fine_trace.note: Source. The staged witness is an `OTTO` font whose directory contains a `CFF2` entry, so this lookup succeeds and the CFF2 branch in `cff_face_init` is taken.
The successful table lookup is materialized on the face as `isCFF2 = 1`. The later fix uses this exact face flag to skip TrueType size reset on CFF2 faces.

The same witness also contains an `MVAR` table, so `ft_var_load_mvar` finishes parsing it and sets `TT_FACE_FLAG_VAR_MVAR`. `tt_apply_mvar` later tests this flag before deciding whether to reset attached sizes.

During face open, `FT_New_Size` allocates the active size object using the current driver's `size_object_size` and links it into `face->sizes_list`. For the CFF driver this size is `sizeof ( CFF_SizeRec )` (`src/cff/cffdrivr.c:1199-1205`), and ASan records this allocation as the 96-byte heap region later overrun.

On the saved `instance_index == 0` path, `setIntermediateAxis` computes midpoint coordinates `(minimum + def) / 2` and calls `FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates`; when that API asks this CFF face to adjust metrics, `cff_metrics_adjust` forwards the request through `face->var`. `sfobjs.c:897-906` initialized `face->var` from the `truetype` module, so the CFF2 face is sent into TrueType's `tt_apply_mvar` implementation.
Because step 3 set `TT_FACE_FLAG_VAR_MVAR`, this guard does not return and `tt_apply_mvar` continues into the post-MVAR size-reset logic for the same CFF2 face.

After updating derived metrics, `tt_apply_mvar` walks every `FT_Size` attached to the face and invokes `tt_size_reset_iterator`. The list it iterates includes the 96-byte CFF size object created in step 4.

The iterator blindly reinterprets each list entry as `TT_Size`. For this node, `node->data` still points to the CFF driver's `CFF_SizeRec`, so `size` becomes a TrueType-typed alias to the smaller CFF layout.

Root cause and sink. The vulnerable function writes the TrueType-only `ttmetrics.valid` field immediately, before it reads `size->root.face` or could apply the later `if ( face->isCFF2 ) return` fix. Because step 8's `size` actually aliases the 96-byte CFF allocation from step 4, this write lands out of bounds; ASan reports address `0x508000000278`, which is 120 bytes past the allocated region `[0x5080000001a0, 0x508000000200)`.

format.name: exact OpenType/CFF2 witness
format.contract: Exactly the staged 3984-byte OpenType font at `gt_results/arvo_42515416/poc` with SHA-256 `0aa475ed5d4161c5cd1bf244d869338500d25bf2b368a959132b99f94782d681`. The witnessed trigger facts are only the ones statically established here: the file advertises `OTTO` and carries the specific `CFF2`, `MVAR`, and `fvar` tables observed above, and Stage 01's saved vulnerable run opens the face with `instance_index == 0` (`face_index` bits 16-30 are 0, so named instances are ignored), then `setIntermediateAxis` passes midpoint coordinates `(minimum + def) / 2` to `FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates`, then the path reaches `tt_apply_mvar` and the out-of-bounds write in `tt_size_reset`. This contract is limited to that exact witness and those observed conditions; it does not generalize to all CFF2 or variable fonts.
